subject: Approval request: PLG trial kickstart credit for Skyward.ai
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: one-time PLG kickstart credit (Skyward.ai)

Hi Lauren / Karthik —

Quick one: Skyward.ai (PLG signup last week) is asking for a self-serve top-up to get them through a 30-day POC. They hit our rate limits and initial token estimate looks like ~35K high-quality inference tokens/day for 30 days (~1M tokens) based on their usage profile. Sales has proposed a one-time credit to avoid losing momentum.

Request: approval to issue a $40,000 credit applied to their hosted account, valid 30 days, with automatic reversion to normal billing after expiration. Attached is a short usage forecast and the proposed credit terms.

Why this is time-sensitive: they are converting several product teams and want to run a cross-team benchmark this week — without the credit they will likely stop experiments and consider a paid competitor.

If approved, I will issue the credit via the self-serve grant flow and confirm with Sam (cc’d).

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Growth Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time PLG kickstart credit (Skyward.ai)

Vanessa — thanks for the context. 

On first pass I’m supportive given the conversion risk and the relatively short window. Two asks before I give final thumbs-up: 1) confirm expected ARR conversion rate if POC succeeds (ballpark % or $) and 2) include a simple guardrail in the credit terms to prevent abuse (e.g., cap on max tokens/day or automatic pause on unusual spike).

If you can add those to the brief, I’ll sign off and route to finance for the accounting entry.

— Karthik
Head of Revenue Ops

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time PLG kickstart credit (Skyward.ai)

Vanessa —

Please include a short note on SSO/data isolation concerns (Skyward hinted at PII-free test corpora but we should be explicit). Also I want the ask to be explicit about whether this is a full credit (covering inference + embeddings/storage) or only inference.

If you can update and include the attachment with those two clarifications, loop back and I’ll get Markus to sign off for >$25k.

Lauren
VP, Growth

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Sam Harper <sam.harper@skyward.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time PLG kickstart credit (Skyward.ai)

Thanks — updated and attached. Key points added:
- This is a one-time credit that covers hosted inference compute and embeddings usage only (not long-term storage or data transfer).
- SSO: Skyward will use a test workspace with no PII, we confirmed via legal thread.
- Guardrail: credit will be enforced with a soft daily token cap of 60K tokens/day and an automated alert to the AE when daily consumption >80% of the cap.

Conversion signal: if POC succeeds we expect a 20–30% chance of a mid-market deal in 90 days (~$80–150k ARR) based on their internal rollout plan (product teams + one pilot customer). Forecast attached (Skyward_usage_forecast_Q4.xlsx).

Sam — added you to the thread so you have visibility. If anything changes on your end about data classification, please let us know.

I will proceed to request final sign-off once I have confirmation from Karthik and Lauren.

Vanessa

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time PLG kickstart credit (Skyward.ai)

Read this morning — thanks for the clear summary. I approve a one-time credit up to $40,000 under the terms Vanessa outlined (inference & embeddings only, 30 days, daily soft cap 60K tokens/day).

Two operational notes to finance/ops: please classify as promo credit (non-recurring) and ensure the credit automatically expires at the 30-day mark; do not convert to a recurring discount. AE to confirm post-POC conversion update.

— Markus
CEO, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sam Harper <sam.harper@skyward.ai>, trial_admin@skyward.ai
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Approval: PLG kickstart credit for Skyward.ai — next steps

Sam — great news: leadership approved the one-time $40k credit under the agreed terms. I will trigger the self-serve grant now and email you the confirmation and redemption window.

Next steps:
- I’ll issue the credit (should reflect in your billing dashboard within 15 minutes).
- We’ll enable the 60K/day soft cap and monitoring alerts.
- Check-in call at 14 days to review consumption and run the checklist for a post-POC conversion conversation.

Thanks all — Vanessa
Account Executive, Growth Accounts
Redwood Inference
